by
  have : Real.log (n + 1) ≤ harmonic n :=
    by
      induction' n with d hd
      · exact le_refl (harmonic 0)
      · rw [harmonic_add, Real.log_add, Real.log_mul]
        refine le_trans (Real.log_le_log (Nat.succ_pos d)) _
        exact le_add_right (Real.log_le_sum (d + 1) (Nat.succ_pos d))
  rw [Real.log, harmonic]
  exact this
